geometrySource: FCC/LMS Mexican foreign-station pattern records in grouped geometry master

policy.crtRole: Defines the current Mexican AM concession universe (vigente or in renewal dataset).
policy.geometryRole: LMS supplies all drawable engineering geometry; CRT values never replace LMS tower engineering.
policy.matching: Exact call/frequency is preferred. Multiple facilities may be resolved by a clearly unique equivalent city. If the current call is absent from LMS, a unique same-frequency facility with a strongly equivalent city may be used as a lineage bridge.
policy.cityThresholds: No-call lineage bridge requires city similarity >=90 and an >=8 point margin over the next candidate; exact-call duplicate resolution requires >=85 and the same margin.
policy.operationalExceptions: A small hand-curated veto list may suppress active flags where strong evidence says a current concession is dark. This list is intentionally explicit and reviewable.
policy.patternSelection: Within a chosen facility, explicit DAY/NIG records are preferred; UNL is fallback only. Highest numeric MX application number is used only as a deterministic selector within that facility/mode.
policy.absenceMeaning: A CRT station with unresolved geometry remains current in stations[] but contributes no active pattern to the map.
